# Point Group Atlas

> Exact tables of 98 point groups (closed subgroups of O(3)) and 116 double point groups (closed subgroups of Pin-(3)): their representations and their data, from the records of the repository.

Each group has a file per section of its document, its formulas in MathML with their TeX, and its data in JSON, SymPy, Wolfram Language and GAP in the repository on GitHub, whose index.json gives the size and SHA-256 digest of each file of the records, the conventions and the schemas of the records; sitemap.json maps the site by volume, group and section.

## Volumes

- [Volume I: point groups](rotation/): its conventions, 98 groups and its references; [the volume as one PDF](rotation/point-group-atlas.pdf)
- [Volume II: double point groups](double/): its conventions, 116 groups and its references; [the volume as one PDF](double/point-group-atlas-double.pdf)

## Notation and data

- [Index of notation](rotation/conventions/notation/): the common notation and selected symbols of the sections, each with its meaning and the section that defines it
- [Conventions, Volume I: point groups](rotation/conventions/)
- [Conventions, Volume II: double point groups](double/conventions/)
- [References](references/)
- [index.json](https://github.com/valbert4/point-group-atlas/raw/7e83da235326c6258f6cdafa751e78d7addf6aef/index.json): the files of the records, the conventions and the schemas of the records, with their sizes and digests
- [sitemap.json](sitemap.json): the files of the site, by group and section
